trello.name: Document prompt injection incident in security log
trello.desc: Hassan to write a proper incident write-up of the support ticket prompt injection attempt. Include the raw ticket content, what the summarizer actually did (garbled routing summary containing 'URGENT'), timestamps, and a severity assessment. File it in the security log. Deadline: this week.

trello.name: Harden ticket pipeline against prompt injection
trello.desc: Wren to add a sanitization layer in the ticket parser: quoted customer content must be delimited and treated as data when sent to the summarizer, with instruction-like content stripped or neutralized. Turn this exact ticket into a regression test fixture that feeds the ticket through and checks the summary stays clean. Also add an eval that runs a small suite of injection attempts against the summarizer on every deploy. Grace approved folding the eval into this same task.

trello.name: Investigate jdoe443 account and password reset email delivery
trello.desc: Wren to check whether jdoe443 is a real account and whether password reset emails are broken for anyone. Review reset email delivery logs for the last week and follow up on the account. If the account is a burner, close it. If resets are actually broken, escalate to its own incident.

trello.name: Provide list of new service accounts since May
trello.desc: Hassan to compile and send Grace the list of service accounts created since May, for use in the quarterly access review. Deadline: Thursday.

trello.name: Run quarterly access review
trello.desc: Grace to run the quarterly access review herself, using Hassan's list of new service accounts created since May as input. Deadline: Friday.
